summary: Contiguous rank row partitions initialize the complete corresponding CSR entries. Before timing, long rows are copied in full into a separate CSR array and every short-row entry is packed into SELL. Every timed runtime-count pass launches the SELL kernel for short rows and the CSR kernel for long rows on separate streams; a device-wide synchronization completes both before the end timestamp. The SELL kernel traverses each original row length (not padded slice width); the long-row kernel multiplies every entry in 4096-entry chunks and sums the products. Both final SASS functions retain complete arithmetic and control.

source_evidence.claim: Long rows retain their nonzeros in CSR while short rows are packed to SELL; kernels cover their disjoint row groups; timed runOnce repeats requested count after optional untimed warmup.
CUDA/MPI/OpenMP build; optimized host/device compilation with separate device multiply/add rounding.

compiled_evidence.claim: Both compiled out-of-line launch branches are inside the runtime-count loop: SELL and conditional long-row launch in the normal nonempty-rank branch, plus the separate long-only branch. The requested count bounds repetition, followed by device-wide synchronization, MPI barrier and end clock.

notes: Work-preserving sparse-format conversion and long-row separation occur before timing. The short-row kernel does not multiply padding; it still multiplies every stored original nonzero. Retained as a methodological variation, not a work-count exclusion.
